study_identification_part.si_4_title: Normative modelling of molecular-based functional circuits captures clinical heterogeneity transdiagnostically in psychiatric patients

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Cam-CAN: Cambridge Centre for Ageing and Neuroscience; UCLA: University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA) phenomics dataset.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "The data utilised is from two existing datasets: CamCAN ageing and UCLA phenomics"

answer.Cam-CAN: healthy ageing controls for normative model training/testing

answer.UCLA: healthy controls for normative model training/testing and clinical cohorts for deviation analyses

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Normative models trained with 70/30 split across CamCAN and UCLA healthy participants; UCLA also includes psychiatric cohorts (SCHZ, BPD, ADHD) used for deviation analyses.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "Firstly, the healthy ageing CamCAN dataset ... was chosen as it spans the full spectrum of healthy ageing... Secondly, the UCLA phenomics dataset ... included healthy individuals as well as multiple psychiatric cohorts"; "A set of HBR models ... trained on healthy participants data from both the UCLA and CamCAN datasets, utilising a 70/30 train test split ... resulting in CamCAN = 346/150 and UCLA = 78/33 train/test subdivisions."
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: Lawn2024.pdf.md: Data availability; Lawn2024.pdf.md: Normative modelling

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: Overall healthy controls: CamCAN N=496 and UCLA N=111 (total 607). Train split: CamCAN 346 and UCLA 78 (total 424).
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: "Following quality control exclusions, imaging data of a total of 607 healthy subjects (CamCAN: N =496...; UCLA: N =111...) were included"; "...70/30 train test split ... resulting in CamCAN = 346/150 and UCLA = 78/33 train/test subdivisions."

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Overall-phase mean and SD computed as weighted mean and pooled SD from CamCAN (N=496, mean 52.3, SD 18.3) and UCLA (N=111, mean 31.2, SD 8.7). Train-phase age stats not reported.

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Overall-phase female/male counts computed from CamCAN (M/F=255/241) and UCLA (M/F=60/51). Train-phase sex breakdown not reported.
